summary: Steep, narrow residential street with homes about 11 m away on both sides.
reasons: Homes 10-12 m away along whole stretch

best_section.where: Seventh Avenue south kerb past the bend, before the dead-end curve

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 11-12 m from the kerb on the south side, more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street, kerb-to-fence; room to stop but tight.
drivers.convention: Few cars parked on the kerb; no-parking signs Mon-Fri 7am-4pm and one no-stopping sign.

flags: Homes about 11 m away on own side
sun_shade: Mixed canopy shade; morning sun from the east filtered by trees.
